items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I know the name, all I know where they was. I mean, I never knew their name.

ctx.x: I know the name, all I know where they was. I mean, I never knew their name. See, none of them fellas, people didn't carry no name at their club at that time like they do now, you know. All they tell you they got a job in Buress, I mean, they put no name on no contract or nothing. They tell you Buress, I mean. I went down there so long, I just couldn't know where it was by heart, I mean. There was no other place to play, it was better than Chauvin. Yeah. They had a funny name there, yeah. Funny name they called…
Well, whoever is going to play, I said, where are you going? I'm going to play for Mr. Soil.

Yeah. Felice, come on, Felice, Felice was in Buress, I mean, that's, you know, that was going to play for him. John Rowell, I mean, at Sunrise, you know. It was just, say the name who was going to play for it, so people would know.
